about: nekozame-ports' catalog: every port in it was looked at before it was added. Each one: what it plays, where it comes from, what you need to play it. tools/catalog.py checks it.

ports.name: Ship of Harkinian
ports.plays: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
ports.needs: Your own Ocarina of Time ROM (N64). It asks for it on first start and makes its game file from it.

ports.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
ports.plays: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
ports.needs: Your own Majora's Mask ROM (N64, USA). It asks for it on first start.

ports.name: Starship
ports.needs: Your own Star Fox 64 ROM (N64, USA 1.1). It asks for it on first start.

ports.name: SpaghettiKart
ports.needs: Your own Mario Kart 64 ROM (N64, USA). It asks for it on first start.

ports.name: Zelda 64: Recompiled
ports.plays: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
ports.needs: Your own Majora's Mask ROM (N64, USA). It asks for it on first start.

ports.name: Unleashed Recompiled
ports.needs: Your own Sonic Unleashed game files (Xbox 360), and its title update. Its installer asks for them on first start.

ports.name: Perfect Dark
ports.needs: Your own Perfect Dark ROM (N64, USA 1.1), named pd.ntsc-final.z64, in its data folder. Its page says where that is.

ports.name: sm64coopdx
ports.needs: Your own Super Mario 64 ROM (N64, USA). It asks for it on first start.

ports.name: NXEngine-evo
ports.needs: Cave Story's data, from the free original game. Its page says how to get it.

ports.name: Sonic Robo Blast 2
ports.needs: Nothing: the game comes with it.

ports.name: EasyRPG Player
ports.needs: The RPG Maker 2000 or 2003 games you want to play.

ports.name: GZDoom
ports.needs: The games' WAD files (DOOM.WAD, DOOM2.WAD...), or the free Freedoom.

ports.name: Crispy Doom
ports.needs: The games' WAD files (DOOM.WAD, DOOM2.WAD...), or the free Freedoom.

ports.name: Doomsday
ports.needs: The games' WAD files.

ports.name: Raze
ports.plays: Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior and other Build engine games
ports.needs: The games' own files.

ports.name: Dhewm 3
ports.needs: Doom 3's game files (the base folder).

ports.name: Ironwail
ports.needs: Quake's id1 folder (pak0.pak, and pak1.pak for the full game), next to it or in its game folder.

ports.name: Hammer of Thyrion
ports.needs: Hexen II's game files.

ports.name: DevilutionX
ports.needs: DIABDAT.MPQ from your Diablo (or spawn.mpq from the free shareware version).

ports.name: OpenMW
ports.needs: Morrowind's game files. Its launcher asks for them on first start.

ports.name: OpenRCT2
ports.needs: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2's files (or RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic's). It asks for them on first start.

ports.name: OpenTTD
ports.needs: Nothing: free graphics and sounds are downloaded in the game.

ports.name: Augustus
ports.needs: Caesar III's game files. It asks for them on first start.

ports.name: OpenTyrian
ports.needs: Nothing: the freeware Tyrian 2.1 comes with it.

ports.name: Chocolate Doom
ports.plays: Doom, Heretic, Hexen, Strife, exactly as in the 90s
ports.needs: The game's WAD file (doom.wad, doom2.wad and so on).

ports.name: The Force Engine
ports.needs: Dark Forces' game files (DARK.GOB and the rest).

ports.name: OpenJKDF2
ports.plays: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II and Mysteries of the Sith
ports.needs: The game's files (the episode and resource folders).

ports.name: DXX-Rebirth
ports.needs: Descent's game files (descent.hog and descent.pig), or the free shareware version.

ports.name: Open Fodder
ports.needs: Cannon Fodder's game files (the DOS or Amiga version).

ports.name: Dune Legacy
ports.needs: Dune II's PAK files.

ports.name: fheroes2
ports.plays: Heroes of Might and Magic II
ports.needs: Heroes II's game files (the free demo works too).

ports.name: doukutsu-rs
ports.plays: Cave Story, with smooth high frame rates and co-op
ports.needs: Cave Story's data, from the free original game. Its page says how to get it.

ports.name: Aerofoil
ports.needs: Nothing: Glider PRO's houses come with it.

ports.name: Hydra Castle Labyrinth
ports.needs: Nothing: the freeware game comes with it.

ports.name: Shuusou Gyoku
ports.plays: Shuusou Gyoku, the first Seihou game
ports.needs: The original game's data files. It says where to put them when it starts.

ports.name: OpenMadoola
ports.needs: The Famicom game's ROM.

ports.name: openQ4
ports.needs: Quake 4's game files (the q4base folder).
